# Prefabs (Summary)

Source: https://hytalemodding.dev/en/docs/guides/prefabs

## Purpose
Create and manage reusable structure prefabs in‑game.

## Core workflow
- Create or enter a prefab editing world.
- Build and select an area.
- Save the selection as a prefab.
- Use the paste tool or prefab commands to place prefabs.

## Key commands
- `/prefab` (save, load, delete, list)
- `/editprefab` (new, load, select, save, saveas, exit, info, etc.)

## Known issues
- Some prefab changes may not immediately update in‑game until re‑entering the world.
